mapper.select: SELECT EXC_REQ_ID, RESOURCE_ID, START_YMD, END_YMD, STATUS_CD, REQ_USER_ID, REQ_DTM FROM TB_EOS_EXC_REQ WHERE 1=1 AND RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId} ORDER BY REQ_DTM DESC
SELECT EXC_REQ_ID, RESOURCE_ID, START_YMD, END_YMD, STATUS_CD, REQ_USER_ID, REQ_DTM FROM TB_EOS_EXC_REQ WHERE STATUS_CD = 'PENDING' ORDER BY REQ_DTM ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EOS_EXC_REQ SET STATUS_CD=#{statusCd}, CHG_USER_ID=#{chgUserId}, CHG_DTM=#{chgDtm} WHERE EXC_REQ_ID=#{excReqId}
UPDATE TB_EOS_RESOURCE SET EXCEPTION_ACTIVE_YN=#{exceptionActiveYn}, CHG_USER_ID=#{chgUserId}, CHG_DTM=#{chgDtm} WHERE RESOURCE_ID=#{resourceId}
